title: Duplicate data fetching across components
summary: Multiple components independently fetch the same data during a single page lifecycle.
rationale: Duplicate fetches increase network traffic and server load while complicating consistency.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Centralize data fetching, deduplicate requests, use shared query caches, and prefetch intentionally.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
